study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective multicenter observational study
exposure: Type of previous uterine incision (unknown or low transverse)
cohort: 15,519 women with term singletons who attempted a trial of labor after 1 previous cesarean delivery between 1999 and 2002.
finding: Women with an unknown uterine incision who attempted a trial of labor were not at increased risk of uterine rupture compared with women with a known low transverse incision.
